`salve-regina.gabc` is a chord-free copy of the read-only local Salve Regina
reference (transcribed by Andrew Hinkley, Liber Usualis 1961 p. 276 and Liber
antiphonarius 1960 p. 68). Tests never write to the reference scores directory.

The corresponding Gregorio sheet uses Letter paper, 45bp side margins,
20pt TeX Gyre Pagella lyrics, staff size 26, staff thickness 45, 24pt lyric
baseline spacing, an 83pt system baseline setting, and a ragged last line.
Measured staff lines are 12.45bp apart and the score occupies eight systems
on two pages. These dimensions are the regression target; Exsurge and TeX
may still choose different line breaks after the opening system.
